description: The any_to_str_bytes rustdoc says TeletexString is unsupported and deferred to v0.2, but does not explain the engineering reason: T61/TeletexString uses a Latin-1 superset encoding that requires dedicated Unicode transcoding per RFC 4518 §2.6; it cannot be treated as raw ASCII. A future maintainer might think they can 'add T61 support by stripping to ASCII' — which would silently produce wrong results on accented characters. Clarify the doc to say: 'TeletexString (T.61 encoding) and BMPString (UTF-16BE) require multi-byte Unicode transcoding per RFC 4518 §2.6 before normalization. This is a deliberate scope boundary, not a simple decoder addition.'
title: any_to_str_bytes: explain why TeletexString is excluded (not just that it is)
